lede: Washington State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +0.7 against -1.0, a 1.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Washington State +5.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Arizona winning 64% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
